messages.author: 72e3318e32f7c9de
messages.subject: Model Compilation Issue on Ubuntu 15.10
parts:
I'm trying to compile a model that works fine on my MacBook (OSX 10.12) with the same version of Stan (2.12). Compilation doesn't work and I have the following error message:

ImportError: /tmp/tmpd9hh4042/stanfit4anon_model_8709480f53105106b608eeda283535a8_3734744325401368722.cpython-35m-x86_64-linux-gnu.so: undefined symbol: _ZTVNSt7__cxx1118basic_stringstreamIcSt11char_traitsIcESaIcEEE


Does anyone know what the reasoning behind this error might be? I'm pretty sure it's not a model issue because this same error has occurred with different models (yes they were similar, however).

Any help is greatly appreciated. Thanks!

messages.author: 72e3318e32f7c9de
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Model Compilation Issue on Ubuntu 15.10
parts:
Okay I worked with some system administrators and apparently it was a linking issue with a libstdc++ object file. The libstdc++.so.6 file was linked to a previous version of it. With this resolved, the model compiles fine.

Thanks for pointing out clang++ that helped narrow things down quicker!
